title: ARI Asset Palette & Capability Filtering
objective: Expose one searchable SAA asset palette over ARI resources with type, collection, rights-capability and requested-operation filtering while preserving ARI as the sole reusable resource/provenance authority and without starting Character actor projection or later export/share behavior.
acceptance: The palette queries ARI-backed resource references rather than duplicating resource bytes or creating a comic-only asset catalog.
Search and filters cover at least resource type, collection and text/query terms with deterministic result ordering.
Rights/use capability filtering occurs before a resource is offered for the requested transform/use operation.
Unsupported or forbidden requested operations fail closed and remain visible as explicit capability state rather than silently exposing the asset.
Palette results preserve ARI resource identity, provenance reference and rights-capability reference.
Selection emits a presentation/reference binding suitable for SAA-03 composition without mutating ARI or source-domain truth.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can search, filter and select assets without requiring drag-and-drop.
Provider-off local operation is supported for locally available ARI catalog state; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-05 Character Actor Projection and later SAA/export/share/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-01.1 identity, SAA-02.1 layout grammar and SAA-03.1 composition canvas remain sealed.
ARI remains reusable resource identity/catalog/provenance/rights authority; SAA-04 is a filtered consumer only.
No source bytes are copied into a parallel SAA asset library by default.
No Character/CAPP/PAPT appearance authority is taken; that begins with SAA-05 projection.
No export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
next_action: Establish causal RED for ARI-backed search/filter, requested-operation fail-closed capability gating, deterministic ordering, provenance/rights identity preservation and accessible selection; then implement only SAA-04.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SAA-04 after verified SAA-03 closeout.
